Full command: git push --force
This command is permanently blocked. Safe route: use 'git push --force-with-lease' instead of a naked --force — it refuses to overwrite a remote ref that has moved since your last fetch. Note --force-with-lease is ALSO blocked by this hook by default; add the exact line 'git-push-force-with-lease' to .claude/destructive_allowlist in the target repo to opt in before using it.
